tei:div.tei:p: 513) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: mkha' spyod zhing bgrod smon lam byang chub lam bzang thar pa'i sgo 'byed zab mo bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ rang snang rnam dag yongs grub 'og min zhing: pad+ma rā ga'i sa gzhi khod snyoms brdal: rin chen sna tshogs gcal bkrams yid 'ong gnas: me tog ljon pa rab rgyas mtsho dkyil dwangs: bya rigs sna tshogs skad snyan chos sgra sgrog: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od kyis bar snang gang: lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyang sprin ltar gtibasaḥ rol mo'i sgra dang mchod sprin dpag med kyis: zhing khams kun dang snang ba'i yul rnams khyab: zhing de'i dbus su rin chen lnga las grub: pho brang chen po tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs: lhun grub gzhal yas khang pa bkod re legs: rang byung gzhal yas khang gi dbus su ni: chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs gdan gyis dbus: pad nyi dus mtshan pho mo'i ro yi steng: rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mo mkha' spyod ma: dmar gsal zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs: dbu skra gyen 'khyil khro mo'i chas kun rdzogs: phyag gnyis g.yas pas 514)gri gug mthur 'phyar 'dzin: g.yon pas bhan thod khrag bkang rdub tshul gyis: phrag g.yon steng nas zhal gyi phyogs su 'dzin: mchan g.yon bcu gsum chas ldan kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: ye shes lnga ldan me ri 'khyil klong du: zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar gyis rol: nu 'bur pad+ma rgyas dang sgeg pa'i mdangs: mthong bas bcu drug dga' ba'i bzhin ngoms shing: mtshan dag dpe byad rab rdzogs rnam dag cing: 'khor dang dbyings spyod ḍā ki mang pos bskor: rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis ldan gyi: sangs rgyas byang sems grub brnyes rig 'dzin dang: bde mchog 'khor lor rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: ma 'dres cha lugs rnam 'gyur du ma'i sku: mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin ye shes sgyu ma'i gar:

'gro ba kun la thugs rjes dgongs te bzhugs: rdo rje btsun mo mchog la gsol ba 'debs: tshe 'di 'phos tshe ḍā ki'i zhal mthong shog: bdag sogs sgo gsum dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid snod bcud 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul: sdom bslab dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rnam dag dge tshogs bsgrubs la rjes 515)yi rangs: zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lor bskor du gsol: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'gro ba sems can yongs la bsngo: mdor na bdag ni tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: rnal 'byor dbang mo'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis: bzung ste mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su khrid: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsus te: rang snang dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog: skyes nas theg chen chos la longs spyod nas: gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro kun 'dren nus shog: chos nyid don dam rnamapar bdag pa dang: chos can kun rdzob bslu med bden pa dang: mkha' spyod dbang mo'i thugs rje nus pa'i mthu: bdag gi rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu yis: smon lam btab pa tshe 'dir 'grub par shog: sa ma ya: de ltar snying nas smon lam btab gyur na: tshe 'dir bar chad kun sel bsam pa 'grub: phyi ma mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor zhabs drung du: skyes nas yon tan yongs rdzogs don gnyis 'grub: the tshom med do badz+ra sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang dge btsun dam pa 516)pad+ma bde gsal gyis yang yang bskul ngor mdo med 'chol mo bde skyong dbang mos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las dag par bris pa'o// dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo'i sgyu 'phrul gar: 'gro la rdzes chags bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal: mi 'gyur sku tshe zhabs pad rab brtan nas: zung 'jug 'bral med mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: ces pa'ang bla ma pad+ma bde gsal gyis bskul ngor/ su kha badz+ra gyis brdzun ris so//
